name: Sophia
source:
Arguably the most powerful Dark Caster of all time (comparing her to [url=/c171590]Vela[/url] would be the Jordan vs Lebron conversation of Eden), but you wouldn’t be able to tell from a first glance. Her mother-like nature makes people instinctively trust her, something she proves is the right decision over and over again. She also has the highest sex drive out of the five witches, but that is something she controls very well… sorta.

[In game description]
